❌ This room is not for professionals

🚫 No racists, no Trump supporters — period.
💶 Rent
€680/month — includes Wi-Fi and household basics.

If you’re clean, considerate, reliable, and a serious nerd 🤓, you shower regularly, wear deodorant, and maybe even express yourself through writing, music, or something that inspires your soul — then we’ll get along beautifully.
If this sounds like you, message me and tell me a little about who you are and what brings you to Munich.
